description_en: Queries the information about subtasks of a PolarDB-X 1.0 distributed change tracking task
description_zh: 查询PolarDB-X 1.0分布式订阅任务下子任务的信息
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-subscription-meta --sid z38m91gg2000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSubscriptionMeta

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the distributed change tracking task.

This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
分布式订阅的实例ID。

本参数为必填参数
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of all change tracking subtasks in the distributed change tracking task. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
You must specify at least one of this parameter and Topics. We recommend that you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
分布式订阅任务下所有的子订阅任务ID。多个子订阅任务ID间以英文逗号（,）分隔。
本参数和参数Topics两者中至少传入一个。推荐填入本参数
parameters.name: sub_migration_job_ids

parameters.help_en:
All topics of the distributed change tracking task. Separate multiple topics with commas (,).
You must specify at least one of this parameter and SubMigrationJobIds. We recommend that you specify SubMigrationJobIds
parameters.help_zh:
分布式订阅任务下所有的订阅Topic。多个订阅Topic间以英文逗号（,）分隔。
本参数和参数SubMigrationJobIds两者中至少传入一个。推荐填入参数SubMigrationJobIds
parameters.name: topics

parameters.help_en: The region in which the change tracking instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid.

SubscriptionMetaList.description_en: The data information about the change tracking subtasks
SubscriptionMetaList.description_zh: 订阅子任务的数据信息

Checkpoint.description_en:
The consumption checkpoint of the subtask, which is the timestamp of the first data record consumed by the client. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
You can use a search engine to find a UNIX timestamp converter
Checkpoint.description_zh:
子任务的消费位点，即客户端消费第一条数据的时间戳。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒。
Unix时间戳转换工具可用搜索引擎获取

DBList.description_en: The objects of the subtask. For more information, see [Objects of DTS tasks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html）
DBList.description_zh: 子任务的订阅对象。详细定义说明，请参见[迁移、同步或订阅对象说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html）

DProxyUrl.description_en: The network address and port number of the change tracking channel
DProxyUrl.description_zh: 数据订阅通道的网络地址及端口号信息

Sid.description_en: The consumer group ID of the subtask

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
